title: My Granddaughter Took $135K, Broke Her Promise, And Vanished. So I Put Her Name On A Mobile Dental Clinic
description: I paid $135K for my granddaughter’s dental school after she promised to serve our town. She called the note a sentimental gesture, abandoned us, and blocked my calls. I sued, won $195K plus interest, and now every garnished dollar funds a mobile clinic bearing her name as the Involuntary Founding Sponsor. #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #MobileDentalClinic
thumb_text: HER PAYCHECK FUNDS THE CLINIC SHE ABANDONED
pinned_comment: What would you do if your granddaughter signed a promissory note, took $135,000 of your late husband's life insurance, then called it a 'sentimental gesture' and blocked you? Share your story in the comments if you've faced a betrayal like this.
